symptoms: Small brown spots that grow into large lesions with concentric rings, like early blight but on younger tissue
Spots first appear on leaves near the ground after fruit set
Stem lesions and dark specks with halos on fruit

severity_cues.early: Few ringed lesions on lower leaves
severity_cues.advanced: Large lesions across the canopy, fruit specking, leaf drop

favorable_conditions: Warm (20 to 28 C), high humidity, long wet periods, dense unpruned canopy

treatment.summary: Scheduled protective fungicide sprays plus canopy and moisture management
steps: Spray Mancozeb 75 WG at 2.0 g per litre, repeat every 7 days
Prune and stake for airflow, remove infected leaves off the field
Avoid overhead irrigation and wet foliage overnight
Rotate out of tomato next season

products.name: Mancozeb 75 WG
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 7 days

products.name: Chlorothalonil 75 WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 7 days

organic: Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 2.5 g per litre as a protectant
Two-year rotation and residue destruction after harvest

source.org: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection, tomato diseases
source.title: Tomato: fungal leaf spot management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not harvest within 7 days of any fungicide spray
